title: Mathematics and science literacy
learning_outcomes: Explain units and ratios in the context of mathematics and science literacy.
Compare and distinguish linear and exponential models in the context of mathematics and science literacy.
Apply graph interpretation in the context of mathematics and science literacy.
Evaluate and justify decisions about quantitative claims in the context of mathematics and science literacy.

lessons.title: Units and ratios
lessons.outcome: Explain units and ratios in the context of mathematics and science literacy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving units and ratios; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to quantitative problem set.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain units and ratios from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of units and ratios; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Linear and exponential models
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish linear and exponential models in the context of mathematics and science literacy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving linear and exponential models; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to quantitative problem set.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain linear and exponential models from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of linear and exponential models; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Graph interpretation
lessons.outcome: Apply graph interpretation in the context of mathematics and science literacy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving graph interpretation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to quantitative problem set.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain graph interpretation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of graph interpretation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Quantitative claims
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about quantitative claims in the context of mathematics and science literacy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving quantitative claims; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to quantitative problem set.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain quantitative claims from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of quantitative claims; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of units and ratios; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of linear and exponential models; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of graph interpretation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of quantitative claims; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Education, statistics or philosophy specialist as relevant.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
